publisher: UK Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
title: Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2025
conversion: Divide original factors by 1000 for emissions per kg of fuel. Sum combustion CO2e and WTT CO2e for the illustrative fuel lifecycle (well-to-wheel) reference.
boundary: Reference fuel production/distribution and combustion only. Not car manufacturing, team operations, freight or supply chain.
limitation: Generic mineral-petrol reference, not the fuel blend, lifecycle factor or officially reported emissions of Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team. Tailpipe CO2 differs from combustion CO2e, which also includes CH4 and N2O.
